minutes.headline: Commission continued most hearings to July 19, approved a sand delivery to Town Beach, and declined to pursue Lot 4 Leominster Road.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission met by Zoom and heard a long run of wetlands hearings. Most were continued to July 19 pending plans or a DEP file number. It approved a negative determination for sand at Town Beach, a negative determination for tree work at 1338 Lancaster Ave, a notice of intent for a septic system at 1074 Lancaster Ave, a field change at 406 Sunset Lane and one certificate of compliance. It also voted not to pursue Lot 4 Leominster Road, and said goodbye to the departing conservation agent.

budget_items.what_was_said: The Parks Commission chair said the facilities department has no equipment and hiring out sand pulling is uneconomical on a small budget, and that the Parks budget had run out early in the season before a new budget arrived.

budget_items.topic: Grant for parking areas on conservation land
budget_items.what_was_said: The state has given its nod to the grant, and the federal side must still approve it. Contract execution is expected around the end of the year.
A contractor estimate for painting is being prepared, and the agent told the facilities director how much is in the Haws fund for the project.

decisions.decision: The Eaton deck applicant may take the existing deck apart now and should submit an as-built drawing showing the same square footage.
The Commission will tell the Board of Selectmen it is not interested in pursuing Lot 4 Leominster Road.

Review of the 238 Fire Road 16 certificate of compliance was put off until the next meeting. The engineer's letter is to state that the house was built as permitted, and a member will make a site visit.

Skate park hearing continued to July 19. The applicant will give the Parks Commission the revised plan and supply the wetland area measurement, planting locations and a maintenance plan for the stormwater structures.

what_happened.line: The Commission continued most of its wetlands hearings to July 19, including the skate park at 100 Chestnut Street, the Eaton deck and the Flat Hill Road garage.
It issued a negative determination for a sand delivery to Town Beach, with a condition to reclaim sand from the lake in the fall; one member voted no.
It voted to tell the Board of Selectmen it is not interested in pursuing Lot 4 Leominster Road.
It approved a replacement septic system at 1074 Lancaster Ave and accepted a field change at 406 Sunset Lane.
It denied an administrative determination for 246 Prospect Street and recommended a formal request for determination of applicability (RDA).

why_it_matters: The Lot 4 Leominster Road vote tells the Selectmen the Commission will not pursue that parcel, so any town purchase of it would not come through the Commission.

The Town Beach discussion noted the facilities department has no sand-pulling equipment and the Parks budget ran out early in the season, which shows how a small line can limit a routine beach upkeep job.
watch_next: July 19 meeting, when most continued hearings return, including the skate park, the Eaton deck and the 238 Fire Road 16 certificate of compliance.
August 2 meeting, when the 131 Island Road tree removal hearing returns.
